flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm,hook/useSearchParams,list/NoticeSearchAllList}, components/datagrid/column; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeController (validoffencenoticelist). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Notice search in the staff portal is complete with the standard parameters (Notice No, ID No, Vehicle No, Processing Stage, suspension/offence/court dates, Suspension Type). It is the general Notice Search page, though; the story order (revival type first, then search) is reversed in code: the officer searches first and then picks Apply Revival, and the search is not limited to notices that can be revived (the Suspension Type filter is optional). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-187 (Pending UAT, sorting the Payment Status column in bulk search results): in this commit the payment_status column already uses source crsReasonOfSuspension (components/datagrid/column/index.tsx:270-272), so what is displayed is unchanged; the UAT status cannot be verified from repo.
recommendation: Claim as the general notice search with standard parameters. Record that the search is not tied to a selected revival type.

steps.step: Officer enters standard parameters: notice no, ID no, vehicle no, processing stage, dates
steps.detail: The All Notices search form has Notice No. (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:64-65), Processing Stage (297-298), ID No. (542-543), Vehicle No. (81-82), Suspension Date From/To (234-265) and Offence Date From/To (471-499). useSearchParams maps them to query parameters: noticeNo[$in], vehicleNo, idNo, lastProcessingStage[$in], noticeDateAndTime (useSearchParams.tsx:322-325, 520-530). The Outstanding search type uses a separate form (NoticeSearchOutstandingForm) that was not read here.

steps.step: OCMS shows the matching notices on screen after the search
steps.detail: The Datagrid calls POST validoffencenoticelist (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:113-135) served by OcmsValidOffenceNoticeController.java:55-62 and shows notice no, type, offence date, place, rule code, stage, vehicle no, suspension, payment status and amount (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:139-172). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-187 about sorting Payment Status does not change what is shown (see note), so the fit stays Sesuai.

steps.step: The search runs after the revival type is selected and only covers notices relevant to that type
steps.detail: The order is reversed: search first, then Apply Revival is picked in the dropdown (NoticeSearchSlot.tsx:281-301). The search has no revival context; the Suspension Type filter (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:201-202) is optional and not pre-filled. Notices without suspension still appear and are only rejected at Apply Revival (see OCMS19.4).
